verdict.summary: Credit deteriorated sharply in FY2026 (ended Sep-26, reported 06-Nov-26): Adj EBITDA fell 41% YoY to $294m (vs $684m FY24) while net debt climbed to $2,050m, spiking trailing net leverage to 7.0x and prompting Fitch to revise the BB outlook to Negative. Sound $707m liquidity ($542m RCF) and Q4 sequential EBITDA bounce ($99m vs $53m Q3) buy time, but graphic paper erosion & ZAR strength threaten BB rating.

positives: Adequate liquidity buffer of $707m ($165m cash + $542m committed undrawn RCF) with long-dated 2032 EUR notes.
Sequential Q4 FY26 EBITDA recovery ($99m vs $53m in Q3) as Somerset PM2 conversion completes.
Strategic pivot away from graphic paper toward dissolving wood pulp (DWP) and packaging/specialties.
negatives: Leverage spike to 7.0x: Net debt reached $2,050m against depressed $294m FY26 Adj EBITDA (-41% YoY).
Fitch BB Negative outlook (late 2026) citing extended deleveraging timeline; high downgrade risk to B+ band if FY27 EBITDA stays <$450m.
Structural European graphic paper decline, stronger ZAR vs USD headwinds, and $319m asset impairments (Matane mill) driving a $747m FY26 net loss.

background.business_overview: Global dissolving wood pulp (Saiccor), packaging/specialty paper, and graphic paper producer with ops in South Africa, US, and Europe.
background.asset_perimeter: South Africa (Saiccor DWP), North America (Somerset/Cloquet), Europe (Maastricht/Gratkorn/etc.); notes issued via Sappi Papier Holding GmbH.
background.ownership_governance: JSE-listed public industrial; diversified international shareholder base.
